note: 'these bones are the whole house of Israel' (Ezek 37:11). The whole house rather than the returned remnant, which is the point of the vision.

'the seven lampstands are the seven churches' (Rev 1:20); Rev 1:11 names them -- Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, Laodicea. The graph holds some of the seven and not all, so this edge is drawn to those it has and the verse is quoted for the rest.
